serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Fishing here would be so cool. We could actually see how they take the bait!
You: You got a little too into it. All you can think about is fishing…
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: And whose fault is that?
You: Not mine, that’s for sure. It’s you who wanted to go fishing with me. 
Bot: Mmmm! 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
You: Woah! Don’t get so angry! I was only joking!
You: Anyway…
